paragraphs: This is my plan for the week. On Monday, I have football class at four o'clock. On Tuesday, I help Dad in the garden. On Wednesday, I go to the library with Ben. On Thursday, I have a piano lesson. On Friday, I sometimes go to Grandpa's house. Every day, I do my homework after school. Do you see a day with no plan? I see one. It is Saturday afternoon, and I have nothing to do!

I like the weekend best. On Saturday morning, I am a player in the school game. Our game is at nine o'clock. I kick the ball and run. Dad and Lily watch the game. On Sunday, we all eat lunch at home. Mom makes rice and chicken. We talk and laugh at the table. Then I play with Pip in the garden. Sunday is a quiet day.

Then it is July. Lily has her birthday in July. Her party is on a Saturday. Lily wants a hundred balloons! Mom says, "That's too many." Lily says, "Then I want twenty." I write the party in my plan. Tom, Lily, and Mom make the cake. My week is busy, but I like it.
text.summary: Tom writes his plan for the week. He lists his school days, his football game on Saturday, and Lily's party in July.
